dimensions.conceptDescription: A method's parameter list and/or return type changed.
A method kept its signature but its conditions, branches or loops changed, so its runtime behavior may differ.
An existing symbol was deleted with no successor.
A method or constructor kept its signature but its body changed in a way no more specific transformation explains.
A new symbol was introduced with no prior counterpart.
What a public API is responsible for doing changed.
An existing capability's behavior changed without being added or removed.
An existing business-meaningful capability was removed.
A new business-meaningful capability was introduced.
